# U34: What you see is what you share: the map’s attention filter, History’s range and an unposted table survive links and refreshes

- **Belongs to:** the Goal map module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `HONEST-NUMBERS`, `SAVED-VIEWS`, `DRAFTS`
- **Budget:** at most 14 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `entry`, `errors`, `one-action` ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Tariq, at `/goals?scope=all&view=map` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, line 2727

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Tariq (`tariq`).
- _Note:_ On the map, what needs attention is the list bar's switch (GL2): in the link, in the count, and in Export.
- Go to `/goals?scope=all&view=map` in the demo.
- **Check:** The “Goal map” section shows.
- **Step.** Press the attention switch (`.attention-switch:visible`).
- **Check:** The address becomes “attention=1”.
- _Note:_ The switch is the Goals screen's Needs attention filter (the one rule), so the link carries attention=1.
- **Check:** (`logged`) the address matches “attention=1” (else: the attention filter is not in the link).
- **Check:** “N needs attention:” is shown (else: the attention filter does not show in the count).
- **Step.** Open the Views menu (the View sheet on a phone) at its Export these goals button.
- **Step.** Press the Export these goals button.
- **Check:** (`attention`) the “shown now:” field in the “Export” dialog is ticked (else: a filtered export does not start from what is shown).
- Press the Escape key.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “map attention”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ History's range is part of the view: chosen, refreshed, still there.
- Go to `/goals?scope=all&view=history&hist=weekly` in the demo.
- **Step.** Press the “Whole year” button in the “Weeks shown” group.
- **Check:** The address becomes “weeks=year”.
- Reload the page.
- **Check:** The “Whole year” button in the “Weeks shown” group shows.
- **Check:** (`finish`) it fails if History forgot the whole-year range on refresh.
- _Note:_ Numbers typed in the one table survive a refresh, and say so.
- Go to `/quick-check-in` in the demo.
- **Check:** A review question’s row shows.
- **Step.** Type “94” into a field in a review question’s row.
- Reload the page.
- **Check:** “Picked up the numbers you hadn’t posted yet” is shown (else: a refreshed table does not say it kept the numbers).
- **Check:** (`progress`) it fails if the typed number was lost on refresh.
- Close this browser.
